Monthly business reporting

Monthly business insights that explain what changed and what to review next

Data Fort turns recurring reporting into a practical monthly rhythm. Instead of asking staff to interpret disconnected exports, owners get a clearer view of customer retention, sales and inventory reporting, refill retention, rebooking, no-shows, product performance, service revenue, and margin visibility.

What the monthly readout can cover

  • What changed in revenue, product mix, service revenue, or category performance.
  • Which customer, patient, or client retention patterns need attention.
  • Where inventory, margins, staff capacity, or booking patterns are affecting results.
  • Which questions should be reviewed before the next month starts.

Who uses it

Monthly business reporting works well for owners, operators, clinic managers, pharmacy managers, store managers, and staff leads who need a consistent way to review performance without building new reports from scratch every month.

Decision rhythm

From numbers to next steps

  • Review the key metrics Start with the dashboard and identify the numbers that moved.
  • Explain the likely drivers Connect the movement to customer behaviour, operations, inventory, staffing, or marketing activity.
  • Choose what to investigate Turn monthly business insights into a focused list of follow-up questions.

Start with a conversation
